svg.title: Historical Week 2 measured performance decisions
svg.desc: These five historical decision cards summarize one earlier M4 Pro, macOS 27, Qwen3-4B, MLX 0.32.0 observation from the former seven-day Week 2 route. Packed W4 decode, fused pointwise kernels, and SIMD-matrix prefill were kept for their measured controls. Decode attention remained optional and inconclusive. Split-K was conditional at the measured 32-token shape and rejected for the fixed 128-token product workload. The metrics used different denominators and are not additive; they are not results from the current checkout.

g.text: One M4 Pro · macOS 27 · Qwen3-4B · MLX 0.32.0 observation

g.aria-label: Packed W4 decode. Product decode increased from 24.38 to 58.90 tokens per second, plus 141.6 percent. Decision: keep for the measured control.
Fused pointwise category. Attributed category time decreased from 5.948 to 1.251 milliseconds, minus 79.0 percent. Decision: keep. This is attributed category time, not product throughput.
g.text: Attributed category time, not product throughput

g.aria-label: SIMD-matrix prefill. Product prefill increased from 106.44 to 721.60 tokens per second, plus 577.9 percent. Decision: keep for the fixed checked workload.

Optional decode attention. Product decode increased from 74.34 to 76.50 tokens per second, plus 2.91 percent. Attributed attention decreased 0.75 percent while total attributed time increased 0.97 percent. Decision: inconclusive and optional, not a universal win.
g.text: Attribution: attention −0.75% · total rose 0.97% · mixed signals
Optional experiment; not a universal win

g.aria-label: Split-K. At 32-token prefill, total attributed time decreased 4.87 percent and projection time decreased 5.01 percent, so retain conditionally at that measured short shape. At the fixed 128-token product control, prefill decreased from 721.60 to 718.36 tokens per second, minus 0.45 percent, and decode changed plus 0.14 percent, so reject for that workload.
g.text: Conditional at this measured short shape
Decode +0.14% · reject for this fixed workload
Different denominators: do not add these changes. See the performance appendix for methods and limits.
